test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The radius of a road roller is 7 m and its length is 14 m. It takes 100 revolutions to level the ground of a field. Find the area of the field. [Use pi = frac{{22}}{7}]
solution:
**Given:**

The radius of a road roller (r) = 7 m

The length of the road roller (h) = 14 m

Number of revolutions = 100

**Formula used:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a cylinder = 2πrh

Area of the field = CSA of road roller × Number of revolutions&
